verdict.rationale: Statsig's docs describe official client and server SDKs, including how to call checkGate with its parameters, return values and exposure logging. The docs also promise data flowing in 'with only a few lines of code' and present the HTTP API as the alternative 'without an SDK', which confirms first-party SDKs are the primary integration path. missing for 10: an SDK overview listing supported languages and platforms, documentation depth beyond the single checkGate reference, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
